# INPUTS

| property | type       | required | default | description                |
| -------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------- |
| build    | ModelBuild | true     | -       | Pipeline build information |

```typescript
interface ModelBuild {
  /** task id, automatically generated by the server */
  id: string;

  /** project id, automatically generated by the server */
  projectId: string;

  /** pipeline id, automatically generated by the server */
  pipelineId: string;

  /** git info, passed in at creation time, cannot be modified */
  git_meta: Partial<ModelGitMeta>;

  /** sender, passed in at creation time, cannot be modified */
  sender: string;

  /** artifact package information */
  artifact: {
    /** package Id */
    packageId?: string;

    /** version Id */
    versionId?: string;

    /** artifact package name */
    packageName?: string;

    /** version name */
    versionName?: string;

    /** artifact package upload time */
    ctime?: string;
  };

  /** creation time, passed in at creation time, cannot be modified */
  created: number;

  /** workflow definition */
  yaml_string: string;

  /** stage status */
  stages: Partial<ModelStageStatus>[];

  /** execution status */
  status: Partial<ModelBuildStatus>;

  /** number */
  number: string;

  /** event list */
  events: string[];
}
```
